linkfilter-desc: Waxay ku dartaa bogag gaar ah oo cusub iyo parser hook loogu talagalay gudbinta/ansixinta/diidmada xiriiriyeyaasha.
linkfilter-nothing-to-approve: Hadda ma jiraan xiriiriyeyaal sugaya ansixin.
linkfilter-no-recently-approved: Dhawaan lama ansixin wax xiriiriyeyaal ah.
linkfilter-no-links-at-all: Weli lama gudbin wax xiriiriyeyaal ah ama maamulayaasha xiriiriyeyaashu weli ma aysan dib u eegin xiriiriyeyaasha la gudbiyay.
linkfilter-submit-no-desc: Fadlan geli sharraxaad ku saabsan xiriiriyahan
linkfilter-login-text: Waa inaad gashan tahay si aad u gudbiso xiriirro.
linkfilter-instructions: Waxaad [[MediaWiki:Linkfilter-instructions|ku dari kartaa tilmaamo loogu talagalay isticmaalayaasha]].
linkfilter-admin-instructions: Waxaad ku dari kartaa [[MediaWiki:Linkfilter-admin-instructions|tilmaamo loogu talagalay maamulayaasha]].
linkfilter-admin-cat-filter: Muuji oo keliya xiriirrada sugaya ansixinta ee qaybta:
linkfilter-edit-summary-link-edited: URL-ka xiriirka waxaa laga beddelay $1 loona beddelay $2
fancycaptcha-linksubmit: Si aad u gudbiso xiriir si loo ansixiyo, fadlan geli erayada hoos ka muuqda sanduuqa ([[Special:Captcha/help|macluumaad dheeraad ah]]):
questycaptcha-linksubmit: Si aad u gudbiso xiriir si loo ansixiyo, fadlan ka jawaab su'aasha hoos ka muuqata ([[Special:Captcha/help|macluumaad dheeraad ah]]):
log-description-linkfilter: Ficillada la xiriira xiriirrada ee lagu sameeyay nidaamka LinkFilter.
logentry-linkfilter-approve: $1 {{GENDER:$1|ansixiyay}} xiriirka cinwaankiisu yahay "$3" oo leh URL-ka $5, sharraxaad "$6" iyo nooc "$7"
logentry-linkfilter-edit: $1 {{GENDER:$1|tafatiray}} xiriirka $3: URL-ku hadda waa $5, sharraxaaddu hadda waa "$6", noocuna hadda waa "$7"
logentry-linkfilter-reject: $1 {{GENDER:$1|diiday}} xiriirka cinwaankiisu yahay "$3" oo leh URL-ka $5, sharraxaad "$6" iyo nooc "$7"
logentry-linkfilter-submit: $1 {{GENDER:$1|gudbiyay}} xiriirka cinwaankiisu yahay "$3" oo leh URL-ka $5, sharraxaad "$6" iyo nooc "$7"
action-linkadmin: Maamul xiriirrada ay soo gudbiyaan isticmaalayaashu
right-linkadmin: Maamul xiriirrada ay soo gudbiyaan isticmaalayaashu
apihelp-linkedit-summary: Tafatir sifooyinka gaarka ah ee xiriir
apihelp-linkedit-param-description: Sharaxaad kooban oo ku saabsan waxa xiriirku yahay
apihelp-linkedit-param-type: Nooca xiriirka oo tiro ah, ka eeg <var>$wgLinkFilterTypes</var> magacyada noocyada xiriirrada ee la fahmi karo
apihelp-linkedit-param-url: Xiriirka dhabta ah, oo ay ku jirto borotokoolka
apihelp-linkedit-example-1: U deji sharraxaadda xiriirka la yiraahdo "Test link" "Xayawaan yaryar oo qurux badan oo maalintaada farxad gelinaya!", URL-ka u deji https://cats.example.com/new-cat-photos-for-today/ oo u beddel qaybta xiriirka "Funny" (aqoonsiga tiro ahaan 4)
apihelp-linksubmit-summary: U dir xiriir safka si uu u eego maamulaha xiriirrada, iyadoo rajadu tahay in la ansixiyo.
apihelp-linksubmit-param-title: Cinwaanka xiriirka, waxaa loo isticmaali doonaa abuurista bogga Xiriirka ee wiki-ga haddii/marka xiriirka uu ansixiyo maamulaha xiriirrada
apihelp-linksubmit-param-description: Sharaxaad kooban oo ku saabsan waxa xiriirku yahay
apihelp-linksubmit-param-type: Nooca xiriirka oo tiro ah, ka eeg <var>$wgLinkFilterTypes</var> magacyada noocyada xiriirrada ee la fahmi karo
apihelp-linksubmit-param-url: Xiriirka la gudbinayo, oo ay ku jirto borotokoolka
apihelp-linksubmit-example-1: Gudbi xiriir cinwaankiisu yahay "Funny cats and kittens", oo leh sharraxaadda "Xayawaan yaryar oo qurux badan oo maalintaada farxad gelinaya!", URL-kuna yahay https://cats.example.com/new-cat-photos-for-today/ kuna jira qaybta xiriirrada "Funny" (aqoonsiga tiro ahaan 4)
apihelp-linkfilter-summary: Qaybta API-da dhabarka dambe ee ansixinta xiriirrada ay soo gudbiyaan isticmaalayaashu
apihelp-linkfilter-param-status: 1 si loo aqbalo, 2 si loo diido
